peintureInterieure.title: Interior painting
peintureInterieure.short: Walls, ceilings and woodwork: crisp, durable finishes for your living and working spaces.
peintureInterieure.intro: A successful interior paint job is 80% preparation. We fill, sand and prime every surface before applying professional-grade paints, for a clean result that lasts.

features.f5: Low-odour paints, suitable for occupied homes

peintureInterieure.body1: Whether you're refreshing a room, preparing a flat for rental or rethinking your whole interior, we adapt to your daily life: agreed working hours, protected spaces, and a tidy site every evening.
peintureInterieure.body2: We advise you on shades and finishes based on the light in your rooms, and we use professional paints known for standing the test of time.

crepisFacades.title: Rendering & façades
crepisFacades.short: Interior and exterior rendering, façade renovation: protect and enhance your building.
crepisFacades.intro: Your façade is your building's first impression — and its first line of defence against the weather. We apply renders and renovate façades with systems suited to the Swiss climate.

features.f5: Wide choice of grains and shades
features.f6: Villas, apartment buildings and commercial premises

crepisFacades.body1: We assess the condition of your façades before any work: cracks, damp, delamination. You receive a precise quote with the right solution — a simple refresh or a complete renovation.
crepisFacades.body2: Indoors, decorative render brings relief and character to your walls: we master the different application techniques for an even, elegant result.

platrerie.title: Plastering
platrerie.short: Partitions, suspended ceilings, skim coats and smoothing: perfectly flat surfaces, ready to paint.
platrerie.intro: A beautiful paint job starts with a perfect surface. Our plastering team builds partitions and suspended ceilings and applies smoothing coats for impeccable results.
platrerie.body1: From creating a new room to repairing a damaged ceiling, we work cleanly and quickly. Plastering and painting done by the same team guarantees a consistent result — and a single point of contact.
platrerie.body2: We work on new builds as well as older buildings, respecting the specific character of each construction.

renovation.title: Interior & exterior renovation
renovation.short: One point of contact to refresh, transform or add value to your property, from A to Z.
renovation.intro: Preparing a sale, a change of tenant, or simply a new chapter? We coordinate all the surface renovation work on your property, inside and out.

features.f1: Full renovation of flats and houses

renovation.body1: One quote, one schedule, one person in charge: we orchestrate every stage so your project moves fast and finishes well. Ideal for property managers and owners who want an impeccable result without juggling contractors.
renovation.body2: We keep you informed at every stage and we stand by the deadlines stated in the quote.

about.title: Artisan standards, Swiss spirit
about.intro: Peinture Suisse is a painting and plastering company based in Lausanne. Our belief is simple: a successful project is a client who recommends us.
about.body1: Every project starts with careful listening: your wishes, your constraints, your budget. Then we advise you honestly — including when the simplest solution is the best one.
about.body2: On site, our method never changes: meticulous surface preparation, professional-grade materials, systematic protection of your spaces and a full clean-up at the end of each day.

values.title: What we guarantee you
values.v1Text: An itemised quote, line by line — the price we announce is the price you pay. No surprise extras.
values.v2Text: Crisp edges, even finishes, invisible joins. That's our signature.
values.v3Text: We keep the deadlines we announce and stay reachable throughout the project.
values.v4Text: Floors and furniture protected, site tidied every evening, full clean-up when the work is done.

faq.title: What clients ask before getting started
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions we hear most often. Yours isn't here? Write to us — we're happy to answer.

q1.a: Yes, no strings attached. We come to you, measure the surfaces, listen to what you want and send you a written, itemised quote — free of charge and with no obligation.

q2.q: How much does painting work cost?
q2.a: It depends mainly on the condition of the surfaces, ceiling height and the finishes you choose. As a guide, expect roughly 25 to 45 CHF per m² for interior painting, preparation included. The quote sets the final price: no extras appearing mid-project.

q3.q: How long does a project take?
q3.a: A single room usually takes 1 to 3 days, a whole flat 1 to 2 weeks depending on the surface area and preparation needed. You receive a precise schedule with your quote, and we stick to it.

q4.q: Can I stay at home during the work?
q4.a: In most cases, yes. We work zone by zone, protect your floors and furniture, use low-odour paints and tidy the site every evening. For a major renovation, we discuss it together in advance.

q5.a: Professional paints known for their durability and coverage. In occupied rooms we favour low-emission products. The exact products are listed in your quote.

q6.a: Yes. We're based in Lausanne and travel across French-speaking Switzerland: Vaud, Geneva, Fribourg, Neuchâtel and Valais. Travel is included in the quote — no surprises.
